implemented: Gamma EM interactions via Geant4 reference physics list FTFP_BERT_EMZ (photoelectric, Compton, Rayleigh, pair production where kinematically allowed)
Secondary e-/e+/gamma transport with production cut 0.010000 mm
Scintillation: Geant4 G4Scintillation, yield linear in energy deposit; photon number Poisson (mean<=10) or Gaussian with sigma = resolution_scale*sqrt(mean) (mean>10)
Emission time: finite rise time and 1 exponential decay component(s)
Optical transport: bulk absorption, boundary process (Fresnel refraction/reflection, surface model unified)
Photodetection: wavelength-dependent PDE applied to each photon entering the sensor window (binomial photon counting)
Sensor timing: constant transit-time offset and Gaussian jitter per detected photon; Gaussian charge noise per event
SiPM microcell saturation (random cell per detected photon) with full dead-time recovery model
not_modelled: Birks quenching and scintillation nonproportionality (yield is linear in deposited energy)
Atomic fluorescence beyond what the production cut and physics list produce
Electronics baseline, shaping, digitisation (only Gaussian charge noise is applied)
SiPM optical crosstalk, afterpulsing, dark counts, PMT transit-time spread and gain fluctuations
Photons transmitted into the surrounding medium are discarded (counted as escaped); re-entry into the crystal is not modelled
Absorption in the optical coupling layer and sensor window (treated as transparent)
Wavelength-dependent reflectivity of the wrapper (constant or tabulated value used as given)
Self-absorption/re-emission (reabsorption without re-emission is represented by the absorption length only)

gamma_calculations.source: Geant4 G4EmCalculator cross-section tables (calculated, not simulated)

time_reference: all times are relative to the first energy deposit in the crystal of each event
config_yaml_text:
# Basic integrated LaBr3:Ce scintillator simulation
# Benchmark temperature: 293 K (Room Temperature)
# Values marked "estimated" are modelling inputs, not measured detector specifications.

config_version: 1

simulation:
  mode: auto
  physics_list: FTFP_BERT_EMZ
  production_cut: {value: 0.01, unit: mm}
  events: 10000
  seed: 12345

output:
  directory: results_LaBr3_Ce_293K
  photon_log: none
  max_logged_photons: 2000000

visualization:
  macro: vis.mac

material:
  name: LaBr3_Ce
  physical_state:
    value: solid
    status: literature
    source: "LaBr3:Ce single crystal"
  composition:
    status: calculated
    source: "Nominal 5% Ce dopant substitution on La site"
    elements:
      - {symbol: La, atoms: 0.95}
      - {symbol: Ce, atoms: 0.05}
      - {symbol: Br, atoms: 3.0}
  density:
    value: 5.08
    unit: g/cm3
    status: literature
    source: "Standard commercial density for LaBr3:Ce"
  temperature:
    value: 293.0
    unit: K
    status: literature
    source: "Standard room temperature benchmark"

crystal:
  shape: box
  dimensions: {x: 10.0, y: 10.0, z: 10.0, unit: mm}

# Crystal-to-surrounding optical boundary and reflector
surface:
  model: unified
  finish: polished
  sigma_alpha: {value: null, unit: deg, status: unknown, source: ""}
  roughness_rms: {value: null, unit: um, status: unknown, source: ""}
  unified_constants: {}
  reflector:
    type: diffuse
    reflectivity:
      value: 0.95
      unit: ""
      status: estimated
      source: "Simplified wavelength-independent PTFE-like reflector"

surrounding:
  nist_material: G4_AIR
  refractive_index:
    value: 1.0003
    unit: ""
    status: literature
    source: "Approximate visible-light refractive index of air"

source:
  particle: gamma
  type: pencil_beam
  energy: {value: 662, unit: keV}
  position: {x: 0, y: 0, z: -30, unit: mm}
  direction: {x: 0, y: 0, z: 1}
  # Kept for compatibility with the existing configuration.
  # Whether this is applied depends on the C++ source implementation.
  cone_half_angle: {value: 10, unit: deg}

# Scintillation photon production and emission timing
scintillation:
  light_yield:
    value: 63000
    unit: photons/MeV
    status: literature
    source: "Standard room temperature light yield for commercial LaBr3:Ce (5% Ce)"
    conditions: "Validated under 662 keV gamma-ray excitation (Cs-137 emission)"
  resolution_scale:
    value: 1.0
    unit: ""
    status: estimated
    source: "Poisson photon statistics; excess fluctuations not modelled"
  emission:
    peak_wavelength:
      value: 380
      unit: nm
      status: literature
      source: "Characteristic Ce3+ emission peak in LaBr3 host lattice"
    fwhm:
      value: 45
      unit: nm
      status: estimated
      source: "Typical standard room temperature emission FWHM"
    spectrum_mode: gaussian
    spectrum_table:
      status: unknown
      source: ""
      x_unit: nm
      intensity_basis: per_wavelength
      points: []
  rise_time:
    value: 0.0
    unit: ns
    status: estimated
    source: "Instantaneous rise-time approximation"
  decay_components:
    - fraction: {value: 1.0, unit: "", status: estimated, source: "Primary fast emission channel dominance"}
      decay_time:
        value: 16.0
        unit: ns
        status: literature
        source: "Characteristic primary fast decay lifetime at room temperature"

# Optical photon transport through the crystal
optical:
  refractive_index:
    value: 1.9
    unit: ""
    status: literature
    source: "Refractive index evaluated near the 380 nm emission peak"
  absorption_length:
    value: 500.0
    unit: mm
    status: estimated
    source: "Highly transparent commercial bulk growth approximation"
  # Optional scattering and wavelength-shifting processes are disabled.
  rayleigh:
    enabled: false
    scattering_length: {value: null, unit: mm, status: unknown, source: ""}
  mie:
    enabled: false
    scattering_length: {value: null, unit: mm, status: unknown, source: ""}
    forward_anisotropy: {value: null, unit: "", status: unknown, source: ""}
    backward_anisotropy: {value: null, unit: "", status: unknown, source: ""}
    forward_ratio: {value: null, unit: "", status: unknown, source: ""}
  wls:
    enabled: false
    absorption_length: {value: null, unit: mm, status: unknown, source: ""}
    mean_photons: {value: null, unit: "", status: unknown, source: ""}
    time_constant: {value: null, unit: ns, status: unknown, source: ""}
    emission_table: {status: unknown, source: "", x_unit: nm, intensity_basis: per_wavelength, points: []}

# One basic detector configuration: SiPM.
# PMT response is not enabled in this simplified benchmark.
sensor:
  type: SiPM
  face: "+z"
  active_area: {width: 6.0, height: 6.0, offset_u: 0.0, offset_v: 0.0, unit: mm}
  model_thickness: {value: 0.5, unit: mm}

  # Optical window and coupling layer between crystal and sensor
  window:
    nist_material: G4_SILICON_DIOXIDE
    refractive_index:
      value: 1.5
      unit: ""
      status: estimated
      source: "Simplified detector-window refractive index"
  coupling:
    type: layer
    nist_material: G4_PLEXIGLASS
    thickness: {value: 0.1, unit: mm, status: estimated, source: "Simplified coupling-layer thickness"}
    refractive_index:
      value: 1.5
      unit: ""
      status: estimated
      source: "Simplified optical-coupling refractive index"

  # Photon detection and charge response
  pde:
    value: 0.40
    unit: ""
    status: estimated
    source: "Constant illustrative SiPM photon-detection efficiency; not a datasheet curve"
  sipm:
    model_saturation: true
    model_recovery: true
    microcell_count: {value: 14400, unit: "", status: estimated, source: "Illustrative 6 x 6 mm2 SiPM with 50 um pitch"}
    gain: {value: 1.0e6, unit: "", status: estimated, source: "Illustrative electrons per fired microcell"}
    recovery_time: {value: 20.0, unit: ns, status: estimated, source: "Simplified microcell recovery time"}

  # Basic timing and electronics parameters.
  # These are configuration additions; C++ must explicitly read and apply them.
  timing:
    transit_time: {value: 0.0, unit: ns, status: estimated, source: "Zero mean transit-time offset for the basic model"}
    time_jitter: {value: 0.0, unit: ns, status: estimated, source: "Timing jitter disabled in the basic model"}
  electronics:
    noise_rms: {value: 0.0, unit: electrons, status: estimated, source: "Electronic noise disabled until a detector-specific value is available"}

  pmt:
    enabled: false
    gain: {value: null, unit: "", status: unknown, source: ""}
